title: Checks for uses of logging.error that pass exc_info=True.
summary: Calling logging.error with exc_info=True is equivalent to calling logging.exception. Using logging.exception is more concise, more readable, and conveys the intent of the logging statement more clearly. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging-format and made it stable in v0.0.236.
message_templates: Logging `.exception(...)` should be used instead of `.error(..., exc_info=True)`

title: Checks for redundant exc_info keyword arguments in logging statements.
summary: exc_info is True by default for logging.exception, and False by default for logging.error. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging-format and made it stable in v0.0.236.
